scoring: sum((5*review_pr + approval_pr + 0.5*nonself_merge_pr) * 2^(-PR_age_days/180) / PR_routing_module_count). One credit per person/PR/module; approval is a review subset. CODEOWNERS only breaks otherwise equal scores.
eligibility: review_prs>=3, weighted_review_prs>=2, distinct_authors>=2, reviews_180d>=1; unknown path modules never auto eligible
limitations: Review expertise is associated with PR modules, not every reviewed line; inline comment paths are not collected.
Issue discussion comments and unsubmitted/self/bot/postmerge reviews do not earn review credit. DISMISSED counts as historical review expertise, not as an approval.
No live collaborator permissions, availability, or pending review workload is inferred from history.
